source.quote: Real Betis Gree Consumer appliances – air conditioning

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
Real Betis Balompié: El Real Betis y Trainline refuerzan su alianza
source.quote: Concretamente, figurará en la parte delantera de la camiseta de trabajo diario y en las de calentamiento, uniéndose así a su presencia en la trasera de las camisetas de juego.
source.note: Same announcement: 'el acuerdo de patrocinio se ha ampliado hasta la campaña 2026/27'. Lower back of the shirt: Blinkfire's 2025-26 LALIGA guide, 'Patrocinador espalda camiseta (Parte inferior): Trainline'.

source.name: Real Betis Balompié: El Real Betis y Prima Seguros firman un acuerdo de patrocinio
source.quote: que arranca el 1 de julio y se extenderá hasta el 30 de junio de 2028, el logo de la insurtech lucirá en la parte superior trasera de las equipaciones de juego
source.note: Prima Seguros, 'la marca de origen italiano' of Prima, on the upper back of the men's first-team match shirt from 2025-26 to 2027-28. Blinkfire's 2025-26 guide: 'Back of jersey (top): Prima Seguros'.

source.name: Real Betis Balompié: Real Betis and AUS Global renew their sponsorship agreement until 2028
source.quote: the international trading company's logo will continue to feature on the first team's match shorts during LALIGA and Copa del Rey matches
source.note: Same release: the renewal extends the partnership 'until the 2027/28 season'; AUS Global has sponsored the club since 2023/24.

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: Danish brand Hummel continued their partnership weith Celta de Vigo and Champions League side Real Betis, while adding promoted side Málaga.
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense.

summary: Gree (front) and REVEL (sleeve) per Score and Change's 2026/27 overview; Trainline (lower back, deal to 2026/27), Prima Seguros (upper back, to 2027/28) and AUS Global (shorts, to 2027/28) per the club's announcements; hummel as kit maker. These are the six Blinkfire's 2025-26 guide lists for Betis, but no 2026-27 source lists the whole kit, so the list is not confirmed complete.
